📦 **sirius-home-menu `2ee33a6`** — feat(food): named town kitchen menus and separate actual ingredient ledger

Expose22 kitchen options without changing IDs, input amounts, calories or selection. Add display metadata to17 direct choices and complete8 missing cooked-meal icons. ArtGalleryafaa6f9 exhibited masters first. Count actual kitchen, extra and meal-service ingredient use; keep daily/luxury purchases out, preserve legacy records with missing-data message. Save separate food and ingredient summaries and expose menu payload.

Four scenarios14 days match baseline5cccfd0 economic state and reports field-for-field except new display data. Independent barley stock delta, service used sums, no standalone wine overlap, copy/townInfo, extra/relief, actual UI and legacy checks pass. Existing365-day jobs and class regressions pass.25 dish icons and22-menu coverage validated with missing-file negatives. Browser fixture uses real townDay data and production renderer; full WebGL not exercised.

Refs TASK-1005

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
